data_source: Tsour et al. 2026 Nature, Supplementary Data 8 (high-confidence SAAP, positional probability > 0.9). doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10678-2
methodology: For each amino-acid substitution observed in the Tsour & Slavov 2026 proteomic dataset (5,873 high-confidence events, 178 unique AA->AA types), we compute the minimum nucleotide-Hamming distance between any source codon (in the standard genetic code) and any target codon. Enrichment tests: (1) event-weighted binomial against all-pair baseline; (2) Fisher exact on single-NT pairs unique observed vs unique unobserved; (3) Mann-Whitney U on NT and bit distances.
